label: Close every open root an Agent no longer holds
summary: repair Agents holding more than one open Session the way boot recovery does

execute.description: repair Agents holding more than one open Session the way boot recovery does
execute.sql:
UPDATE "agentSession" SET "status" = 'closed'
WHERE "id" IN (
  SELECT stale."id"
  FROM "agentSession" stale
  WHERE stale."parentSessionId" IS NULL AND stale."status" = 'open'
    AND stale."id" <> COALESCE(
      (SELECT pointed."id"
       FROM "agent" holder
       JOIN "agentSession" pointed ON pointed."id" = holder."currentSessionId"
       WHERE holder."id" = stale."agentId"
         AND pointed."agentId" = stale."agentId"
         AND pointed."parentSessionId" IS NULL
         AND pointed."status" = 'open'),
      (SELECT newest."id"
       FROM "agentSession" newest
       WHERE newest."agentId" = stale."agentId"
         AND newest."parentSessionId" IS NULL
         AND newest."status" = 'open'
       ORDER BY newest."createdAt" DESC, newest."id" DESC
       LIMIT 1))
)

label: Adopt every existing Session as its own tree root
summary: root each surviving Session at itself and record its unaudited completeness

execute.description: root each surviving Session at itself and record its unaudited completeness
execute.sql:
UPDATE "agentSession" SET
  "rootSessionId" = "id",
  "parentSessionId" = NULL,
  "completeness" = CASE "status" WHEN 'open' THEN 'recording' ELSE 'unaudited' END

  "completeness" TEXT DEFAULT 'recording' NOT NULL,

)
